content.query:
// =====================================================
// FortiGate - Source Country Traffic Map
// =====================================================

let CountryStats =
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend
    SourceCountry = trim(" ", extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,tostring(AdditionalExtensions))),
    Action = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)",1,tostring(AdditionalExtensions)))
| where isnotempty(SourceCountry)
| where SourceCountry !in ("Reserved","Unknown","N/A","")
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    Allowed = countif(Action in ("accept","pass","close")),
    Denied = countif(Action in ("deny","drop","reject")),
    UniqueIPs = dcount(SourceIP)
by SourceCountry;

let TopSourceIP =
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend
    SourceCountry = trim(" ", extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,tostring(AdditionalExtensions)))
| summarize SourceIPEvents = count() by SourceCountry, SourceIP
| summarize arg_max(SourceIPEvents, SourceIP) by SourceCountry;

let MaxEvents =
toscalar(
    CountryStats
    | summarize max(Events)
);

CountryStats
| join kind=leftouter TopSourceIP on SourceCountry
| extend
    EventLevel = case(
        Events >= 50000, "Excessive",
        Events >= 10000, "High",
        Events >= 5000,  "Medium",
        "Low"
    ),

    ColorValue = case(
        Events >= 50000, 4,
        Events >= 10000, 3,
        Events >= 5000,  2,
        1
    )
| project
    SourceCountry,
    Events,
    Allowed,
    Denied,
    UniqueIPs,
    TopSourceIP = SourceIP,
    EventLevel,
    ColorValue
| order by Events desc
content.title: Source Country

content.query:
// =====================================================
// FortiGate - Destination Country Traffic Map
// =====================================================

let CountryStats =
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend
    DestinationCountry = trim(" ", extract(@"FTNTFGTdstcountry=([^;]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions))),
    Action = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions)))
| where isnotempty(DestinationCountry)
| where DestinationCountry !in ("Reserved", "Unknown", "N/A", "")
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    Allowed = countif(Action in ("accept","pass","close")),
    Denied = countif(Action in ("deny","drop","reject")),
    UniqueDestinationIPs = dcount(DestinationIP)

let TopDestinationIP =
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend

| where DestinationCountry !in ("Reserved", "Unknown", "N/A", "")
| summarize DestinationIPEvents = count() by DestinationCountry, DestinationIP
| summarize arg_max(DestinationIPEvents, DestinationIP) by DestinationCountry;

CountryStats
| join kind=leftouter TopDestinationIP on DestinationCountry
| extend
    EventLevel = case(
        Events >= 50000, "Excessive",
        Events >= 10000, "High",
        Events >= 5000,  "Medium",
        "Low"
    ),
    ColorValue = case(

    Allowed,
    Denied,
    UniqueDestinationIPs,

content.query:
// ================================================
// FortiGate Firewall Health Monitoring
// Real-Time | Last 7 Days | Hourly
// ================================================

CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"

| extend Raw = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)

| where Activity =~ "event:system"
    or Raw has "FTNTFGTmem"
    or Raw has "FTNTFGTtotalsession"

| extend
    Memory = todouble(extract(@"FTNTFGTmem=([0-9\.]+)", 1, Raw)),
    Sessions = todouble(extract(@"FTNTFGTtotalsession=([0-9]+)", 1, Raw))

| where isnotnull(Memory) or isnotnull(Sessions)

| summarize
    AvgMemory = round(avg(Memory), 1),
    PeakMemory = round(max(Memory), 1),
    AvgSessions = round(avg(Sessions), 0),
    PeakSessions = max(Sessions)
by TimeBucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

| extend HealthStatus = case(
    PeakMemory >= 90, "Critical",
    PeakMemory >= 80, "High",
    PeakMemory >= 70, "Warning",
    "Healthy"
)

| project
    TimeBucket,
    AvgMemory,
    PeakMemory,
    AvgSessions,
    PeakSessions,
    HealthStatus

| order by TimeBucket asc
content.title: FortiGate System Health Monitoring

content.query:
// =====================================================
// FortiGate - Network Traffic Trend
// Last 30 Days | 6-Hour Intervals | Auto Updating
// =====================================================

FortinetFortigateNetworkSessionSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| extend
    Sent = coalesce(tolong(SentBytes), 0),
    Received = coalesce(tolong(ReceivedBytes), 0)
| summarize
    Sessions = count(),
    SentGB = round(sum(Sent) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    ReceivedGB = round(sum(Received) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    TotalGB = round((sum(Sent) + sum(Received)) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2)
by TimeBucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 6h)
| order by TimeBucket asc

CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend DstPort = iff(isnotempty(tostring(DestinationPort)), tostring(DestinationPort), "OtherPorts")
| summarize
    TotalEvent = count(),
    DestIPs = make_set(DestinationIP, 5),
    Protocols = make_set(ApplicationProtocol, 5)
  by DstPort
| order by TotalEvent desc
content.title: Top Destination Port

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(15m)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend RawExt = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)
| extend Action = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)", 1, RawExt))

| extend BandwidthMB = (coalesce(toreal(SentBytes), 0.0) + coalesce(toreal(ReceivedBytes), 0.0)) / 1024.0 / 1024.0

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend RawExt = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)

| extend Action = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)",1,RawExt))

| extend Result = case(
    Action in ("accept","pass","close"), "🟢 Allowed",
    Action in ("deny","drop","reject"), "🔴 Blocked",
    "🟡 Other"
)

| extend App = extract(@"FTNTFGTapp=([^;]+)",1,RawExt)
| extend AppCat = extract(@"FTNTFGTappcat=([^;]+)",1,RawExt)

| extend Why = case(
    Result contains "Blocked", coalesce(App, AppCat, tostring(Message), "Blocked by Firewall Policy"),
    Result contains "Allowed", coalesce(App, AppCat, tostring(Message), "Allowed by Firewall Policy"),
    coalesce(App, AppCat, tostring(Message), "Other")
)

//
// Highlight Unscanned
//
| extend Why =
case(
    tolower(Why) contains "unscanned", "🚨 🔴 UNSCANNED",
    Why
)

| summarize
    Sessions = count(),
    SourceIPs = dcount(SourceIP),
    DestinationIPs = dcount(DestinationIP)
by
    Result,
    Action,
    Why,
    App,
    AppCat,
    DestinationPort

| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Traffic Summary by Action Details

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend RawExt = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)
| extend Action = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)", 1, RawExt))
| extend Result = case(
    Action in ("accept", "pass", "close"), "Allowed",
    Action in ("deny", "drop", "reject"), "Blocked",
    "Other")
| extend PolicyName = extract(@"FTNTFGTpolicyname=([^;]+)", 1, RawExt)
| extend App = extract(@"FTNTFGTapp=([^;]+)", 1, RawExt)
| extend AppCat = extract(@"FTNTFGTappcat=([^;]+)", 1, RawExt)
| extend Why = case(
    Result == "Blocked", coalesce(PolicyName, App, AppCat, tostring(Message), "Blocked by firewall policy"),
    Result == "Allowed", coalesce(PolicyName, App, AppCat, tostring(Message), "Allowed by firewall policy"),
    coalesce(PolicyName, App, AppCat, tostring(Message), "Other"))
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    SrcIPs = dcount(SourceIP),
    DstIPs = dcount(DestinationIP)
  by Result, Action, Why
//| top 20 by Events desc

// =======================================================
// Top 10 Bandwidth Consumers - FortiGate
// Combines FortiGate firewall traffic logs with Microsoft Defender device inventory
// =======================================================

let DeviceMap =
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where isnotempty(LocalIP)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceName) by SourceIP = LocalIP
| project SourceIP, DeviceName;

CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"

| extend RawExt = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)

| extend SourceCountry = extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)", 1, RawExt)

| extend SourceCountry = case(
    isempty(SourceCountry), "🌐 Unknown",
    SourceCountry == "Reserved", "🏢 Internal",
    strcat("🌍 ", SourceCountry)
)

| summarize
    Sessions = count(),
    UploadGB = round(sum(todouble(SentBytes)) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    DownloadGB = round(sum(todouble(ReceivedBytes)) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    TotalGB = round((sum(todouble(SentBytes)) + sum(todouble(ReceivedBytes))) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2)
by
    SourceIP,
    SourceCountry

| join kind=leftouter DeviceMap on SourceIP

| extend DeviceName = iff(isempty(DeviceName), "🌐 External Device", DeviceName)

| extend TrafficLevel = case(
    TotalGB >= 1000, "🔥 Critical",
    TotalGB >= 500,  "🔴 Very High",
    TotalGB >= 100,  "🟠 High",
    TotalGB >= 20,   "🟡 Medium",
                     "🟢 Low"
)

//| top 10 by TotalGB desc

| project
    DeviceName,
    SourceIP,
    SourceCountry,
    Sessions,
    UploadGB,
    DownloadGB,
    TotalGB,
    TrafficLevel

| order by TotalGB desc
content.title: Top Bandwidth Consumers

// =====================================================
// FortiGate - Live Top Bandwidth Consumers
// Auto Refresh | Last 24 Hours
// =====================================================

FortinetFortigateNetworkSessionSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(SourceIP)

| extend
    Sent = coalesce(todouble(SentBytes), 0.0),
    Received = coalesce(todouble(ReceivedBytes), 0.0)

| summarize
    Sessions = sum(Count),
    TotalTrafficGB = round((sum(Sent) + sum(Received)) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    UploadGB = round(sum(Sent) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    DownloadGB = round(sum(Received) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    DestinationIPs = dcount(DestinationIP)
by SourceIP

| extend
    TrafficLevel = case(
        TotalTrafficGB >= 50, "🔥 Critical",
        TotalTrafficGB >= 20, "🔴 High",
        TotalTrafficGB >= 5,  "🟠 Medium",
        TotalTrafficGB > 0,   "🟢 Low",
        "⚪ No Traffic"
    )
| order by TotalTrafficGB desc
content.title: Top Bandwith Trend

content.query:
// =====================================================
// FortiGate Policy Bandwidth Summary
// Last 7 Days | Hourly | Auto Updating
// =====================================================

CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"

| extend Raw = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)

| extend
    PolicyName = trim(" ", extract(@"FTNTFGTpolicyname=([^;]+)", 1, Raw)),
    PolicyID = trim(" ", extract(@"FTNTFGTpolicyid=([^;]+)", 1, Raw))

| extend
    PolicyName = iff(isempty(PolicyName), strcat("Policy-", PolicyID), PolicyName),
    SentGB = todouble(SentBytes) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0,
    ReceivedGB = todouble(ReceivedBytes) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0

| summarize
    Sessions = count(),
    UploadGB = round(sum(SentGB), 2),
    DownloadGB = round(sum(ReceivedGB), 2),
    TotalGB = round(sum(SentGB + ReceivedGB), 2)
by
    TimeBucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h),
    PolicyName,
    PolicyID

| extend TrafficLevel = case(
    TotalGB >= 100, "Critical",
    TotalGB >= 50, "High",
    TotalGB >= 10, "Medium",
    "Low"
)

| order by TimeBucket asc, TotalGB desc
content.title: Top Firewall Policies by Traffic

content.query:
// =====================================================
// Threat Detection Trend (Day by Day)
// =====================================================

CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"

| extend Raw = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)

| extend
    EventType = extract(@"FTNTFGTeventtype=([^;]+)",1,Raw),
    SubType = extract(@"FTNTFGTsubtype=([^;]+)",1,Raw),
    Severity = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTseverity=([^;]+)",1,Raw)),
    Threat = extract(@"FTNTFGTattack=([^;]+)",1,Raw)

| where EventType in ("signature","utm")
    or SubType in ("ips","virus","app-ctrl","webfilter","anomaly")
    or isnotempty(Threat)

| extend Severity = case(
    Severity == "critical","🔥 Critical",
    Severity == "high","🔴 High",
    Severity == "medium","🟠 Medium",
    Severity == "low","🟢 Low",
    "⚪ Unknown"
)

| summarize ThreatDetections = count()
    by bin(TimeGenerated,1d), Severity

| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Threat Detection Trend

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where ResourceProvider =~ "MICROSOFT.LOGIC"
| summarize
    Succeeded = countif(status_s == "Succeeded"),
    Failed = countif(status_s == "Failed")
| extend TotalCompleted = Succeeded + Failed
| extend SuccessRate = round(100.0 * todouble(Succeeded) / iif(TotalCompleted == 0, 1.0, todouble(TotalCompleted)), 2)
| project SuccessRate, Succeeded, Failed, TotalCompleted
content.title: Automation Success Rate

content.query:
// =======================================================
// Top Detection Rules Performance Dashboard
// =======================================================

let TotalIncidents =
    toscalar(
        SecurityIncident
        | summarize Total = dcount(IncidentNumber)
    );

let IncidentAlertMap =
    SecurityIncident
    | mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
    | project
        IncidentNumber,
        Status,
        CreatedTime,
        ClosedTime,
        AlertId;

IncidentAlertMap
| join kind=leftouter (
    SecurityAlert
    | project
        SystemAlertId,
        AlertName,
        AlertSeverity,
        AlertTime = TimeGenerated
) on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| where isnotempty(AlertName)
| summarize
    Incidents = dcount(IncidentNumber),
    ActiveIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, Status =~ "Active"),
    ClosedIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, Status =~ "Closed"),
    HighSeverityIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, AlertSeverity =~ "High"),
    MediumSeverityIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, AlertSeverity =~ "Medium"),
    LowSeverityIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, AlertSeverity =~ "Low"),
    AvgClosureHours = avgif(datetime_diff("hour", ClosedTime, CreatedTime), Status =~ "Closed"),
    LastTriggered = max(AlertTime)
    by AlertName
| extend
    IncidentSharePct = iff(
        TotalIncidents == 0,
        0.0,
        round(100.0 * todouble(Incidents) / todouble(TotalIncidents), 2)
    ),
    ClosureRatePct = iff(
        Incidents == 0,
        0.0,
        round(100.0 * todouble(ClosedIncidents) / todouble(Incidents), 2)
    ),
    RiskLevel = case(
        HighSeverityIncidents >= 10, "🔴 Critical",
        HighSeverityIncidents >= 5, "🟠 High",
        MediumSeverityIncidents >= 5, "🟡 Medium",
        "🟢 Low"
    )
| project
    AlertName,
    RiskLevel,
    Incidents,
    IncidentSharePct,
    ClosureRatePct,
    ActiveIncidents,
    ClosedIncidents,
    HighSeverityIncidents,
    MediumSeverityIncidents,
    LowSeverityIncidents,
    AvgClosureHours = round(AvgClosureHours, 2),
    LastTriggered
| order by
    HighSeverityIncidents desc,
    Incidents desc,
    LastTriggered desc
content.title: Detection Rules Performance

// =====================================================
// FortiGate Event Trend
// =====================================================

CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"

| extend Raw = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)
| extend Action = tolower(extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)",1,Raw))

| summarize
    TotalEvents = count(),
    Allowed = countif(Action in ("accept","pass","close")),

| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.query:
// =====================================================
// FortiGate UTM Modules Log Volume
// Last 30 Days
// =====================================================

CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend Raw = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)
| extend UTMModule = case(
    Raw has "appcat=" or Raw has "appid=", "Application Control",
    Raw has "webfilter", "Web Filter",
    Raw has "dnsfilter", "DNS Filter",
    Raw has "ssl", "SSL Inspection",
    Raw has "ips", "IPS",
    Raw has "virus" or Raw has "antivirus", "Antivirus",
    "Other UTM modules"
)
| summarize
    LogCount = count(),
    EventCount = sum(EventCount)
    by UTMModule
| order by LogCount desc
content.title: FortiGate Log Volume by Category

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| where Activity has "vpn"
| extend Raw = tostring(AdditionalExtensions)
| extend Result = extract(@"FTNTFGTresult=([^;]+)",1,Raw)
| extend VPNStatus =
    case(
        Activity has "failure" or Activity has "negotiate_error" or Result =~ "ERROR", "Failure",
        Activity has "login" or Activity has "connect" or Activity has "tunnel-up" or Result =~ "OK", "Success",
        "Other"
    )
| summarize Events=count() by VPNStatus
content.title: VPN Connectivity Status
